dialogDescription: Changes are saved automatically for all terminals on this device and synced across its windows.
fontWeightHelp: Adjust text thickness. Try Medium with a background image.
fontHelp: System fonts must be installed on this device. A bundled monospace font is used otherwise.
previewHelp: Local, read-only sample. Click the preview to see cursor blinking.
previewLoadFailed: Preview failed to load. Please reopen settings.
backgroundFileHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB. Local images are included in settings exports; remote images are stored as URLs.
backgroundInvalid: Unable to load the image. Check its format, size and URL.
backgroundImageOpacityHelp: The background covers the entire terminal workspace, including the connection home and tab bar. Higher values make the image more visible. Lower the opacity to improve text readability.
copyOnSelectDescription: Automatically copy text selected with the mouse.
rightClickPasteDescription: Paste clipboard text by right-clicking the terminal.
multiLinePasteHelp: Preview multiline text that could execute commands, or text longer than 5000 characters. Shells with bracketed paste support do not prompt merely for newlines.
shortcutHelp: Use a combination with Ctrl, Alt or Meta. Clearing scrollback does not delete server command history. Ctrl+L is passed to the remote program by default.
zoomHelp: Font shortcuts temporarily zoom this terminal only. Changing the font size in Appearance resets the zoom.
shortcutsPlaceholder: Click and press a key combination
shortcutsRecordPlaceholder: Press a Ctrl / Alt / Meta combination…
shortcutConflict: This combination is already used by another terminal action.
scrollbackHelp: Keeps output in this terminal, not in a log file. Reducing the limit immediately discards older lines and cannot be undone.
inactiveHelp: Based on terminal input. Reading output does not reset the timer. Only reminds; never disconnects automatically.
autoReconnectDescription: Retry after an unexpected disconnect. Normal exits do not reconnect, and running programs are not automatically restored.
completionModeAutoHelp: Show EasySSH suggestions while typing or on Tab. Tab or Enter inserts a selected suggestion without executing it.
completionModeTabHelp: Show suggestions on Tab; pass Tab to the server shell if there are no suggestions.
completionModeOffHelp: Disable EasySSH completion while keeping server shell key behavior.
completionUseHistoryDescription: Suggest commands from this session and the server shell. Turning this off stops local completion history collection and clears its cache; server history is not deleted.
completionUseScriptsDescription: Suggest commands from the script library.
completionUseRemotePathsDescription: Read server paths to complete commands such as cd, ls and cat.
saveFailed: Settings could not be saved and were not applied. Check local storage space and browser permissions.
importFailed: Import failed. Choose valid terminal settings exported by this version.
replaceConfirmHelp: Replace device settings and apply them to all terminals. {count} settings differ. Reducing scrollback discards older output.
clipboardReadFailed: Cannot read the clipboard. Allow clipboard access or use the system paste menu.
clipboardAutoCopyFailed: Automatic copy failed. Use the copy shortcut and check clipboard permissions.
searchMove: Drag to move search, or focus and use the arrow keys
pasteConfirmHelp: {lines} lines, {chars} characters. Pasting may execute commands immediately. Only the first 3000 characters are previewed.
